note: T110 menu helper: food words for reading menus and asking about dishes. Written by the model (not a native speaker); see docs/research/PHRASES.md (Menu words) before relying on any word. 'flags' mean the food usually contains that (pork, shellfish, nuts, alcohol...); 'meat' is implied by pork, beef and poultry. 'roman' is a pronunciation guide for non-Latin scripts: Hepburn (ja), Hanyu Pinyin with tone marks (zh-Hans), Revised Romanization (ko), simple RTGS without tone marks (th). Regional alternatives are shown in brackets. 'also' holds extra English search words.
